# RedTeam Go Release Notes: November 9, 2026

- 4 MIN READ
- November 9, 2026

### Present Project Costs Your Way

The Expanded Division Report lets you show costs by Division or Cost Code, keep your markups in the pricing or show them separately, and preview it all before you send it. Your estimate won't change.

### Improved

**See the Expanded Division Report on screen**

Bidding → Expanded Division Report now shows each division with its total.

Expand a division to see its cost codes, amounts and subtotal, just as they print. Pick the version at the top and click "Preview report." Your choices are saved for the project and used in the Proposal package.

![nov9-not expanded](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/after-01_screen_zero-price-banner_ringed-1280x608.png)

![expanded division report](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/after-03_screen_w-markups_overhead-profit_ringed-1280x792.png)

![printed report before and after](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Printed-Report_-Before_After.png)

**A cleaner printed report**

The project total sits up front, amounts line up in a clear table, and every page has a page number.

Only the layout has changed; your amounts and totals are the same.

**Choose which markups show as their own lines**

The Expanded Division Report w/Markups (formerly Expanded Division Report w/Profit) lets you show Labor Burden, Sales Tax, General Liability, Overhead, or Profit as separate lines — each with its percent.

Profit is the default selection, and the total stays the same to the cent.

**Custom Markup**

The last line in Set Markups is now called Custom Markup by default, and you can still name it whatever you like.

When you use Custom Markup, it shows as its own line on both versions of the report. When you don't, it stays off the report.

![custom markups](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/markups_newgonov92026.png)

### Changed Behavior

Before

After

BeforeThe report was called Expanded Division Report w/Profit.

AfterIt is now Expanded Division Report w/Markups. Profit is still selected by default.

BeforeThe screen showed a GC General Costs row.

AfterThe row is gone. It never printed. To show liability as its own line, select General Liability.

### Fixed

- Cost per square foot is left off the Expanded Division Report when the project has no square footage, instead of printing $0.00.

### FAQs

##### Where did the "w/Profit" report go?

It is now called Expanded Division Report w/Markups. Profit is still checked by default, so it prints the same unless you check other markups.

##### How do I open the report now?

Bidding → Expanded Division Report. Pick the version at the top, then click Preview report.

##### Can I show Overhead or Sales Tax as its own line?

Yes. Choose the w/Markups version and check the markups you want on their own lines. Each one shows its percent.

##### Where did GC General Costs go?

It was removed from the screen because it never printed. To show liability as its own line, check General Liability in the w/ markups version.

##### Are my choices saved?

Yes, automatically, per project. There is no Save button; a "Saved for this project" message confirms each change. The Proposal package uses the same choices.



##### Why can't I uncheck the Custom Markup?

The Custom Markup is added after all other markups and isn't part of any cost code, so it can't be spread into the amounts. It always shows as its own line so the report adds up to your total. If you don't use it, it doesn't show.

##### What does hovering over an amount show?

The markups included in that amount, the same as on the Bid Worksheet.

##### Can I hide $0.00 lines from the owner?

No. They still print. The screen flags them so you can add a price or remove the cost code on the Bid Worksheet.

##### Do my totals change on the printed report?

No. Both versions add up to the same total as before, to the cent.

##### Why doesn't Cost/Sq. Foot print anymore?

It is left off when the project has no square footage. Add square footage in Set Markups and it prints.

##### Need help?

Visit the [Help Center](https://help.redteam.com/en/) or contact your Customer Success Manager.
